g_policy.reason: The banner is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (30 minutes without sponsored stories), declining leaves the feed unchanged, and an 'if the ad fails' path is defined.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 30 minutes without sponsored cards, a feature_time reward with no cash value.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an article-open counter reaching 3 on the home feed, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The idea removes, locks, or caps nothing free. Sponsored cards return as normal after the window, and declining changes nothing.

g_brand_safety.reason: The banner is a list card on s01, which is rated safe, and it sits beside no unsafe or unknown content. It is not in a conversation and there is no chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: As a product_change, the new resource is an ad-free reading window that the player uses themselves in the observed read-a-story flow (f01, s01 to s02). None of the reward goes to another party.

c2_evidence.reason: 'The app has no paywall, limit, or currency' and 'This app has nothing locked' are stated as facts about the whole app. The model's open question only says none was seen on the home feed, and the Inbox was blocked, so the wording is not 'not seen'. 'The only friction a free reader meets' is likewise unsupported.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: No paid plan was observed. The reward expires after 30 minutes and takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The offer appears when the reader returns to the feed after a finished read, not in the middle of an article. That counts as a finished-action moment.

c6_fits_simula.reason: 'The prize is given when the reader closes the game, played or not' grants the reward on a close rather than on the verified play (REWARD_VERIFIED). The flow step 'When the reader closes the game, played or not' repeats this.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Taboola native cards in the home feed and in articles, the feed-to-article loop, and the category pill bar of this app.

other_concern: The ad-free window costs the app its own native ad revenue, and the claim that one game earns more than the hidden cards is only a prediction. The 'one more break is available' note when the window ends may feel pushy. The claim that the offer suits a North American audience is speculative.
